items.title: Shopify is moving from React Native back to Swift and Kotlin
items.content:
--- Top Comments ---

[hectdev]: As an iOS Engineer that has been fighting the battle against every C-level type who brings up the subject of a shared codebase my whole career, I feel very validated.

[atonse]: We did the same thing - had 90% of it overnight. Then spent a few days in the background tweaking for polish. Our app is smaller, and has about 15-20 screens. I started at about 12:30am by giving codex a goal and it inventoried every screen based on the react native code, then created android and iOS directories, used maestro (I had already set up this tooling for a previous personal app build a few weeks prior), and had the whole thing working in android and iOS in the morning. Took it about...

[netshade]: I agree w/ advising people to move off React Native, though I think the story that "LLM enabled an otherwise too-expensive migration to consider" is not correct. I say this because I was part of a migration from a mid-size React Native app to a Swift/Kotlin native app redo. I did the majority of the technical work on it. The majority of the work occurred before January 2026 and without LLM code assistance, though later features in the app definitely used some. For anyone c...

[tonic_note]: Models have gotten a lot better at generating native iOS apps. The main appeal of RN was being able to leverage your web devs for mobile dev. that's what I did at my last company. And it's fine for a startup, but eventually you want dedicated native engineers bc each platform really deserves its own technical masters who can optimize for it. But now that all code is generated, there's little upside to having an RN app... just start native. Your devs are barely going to be writi...

[fnthawar2]: We don’t hold on to a decision just because it was successful at the time. When a core assumption changes, we’re willing to go back and ask whether it’s still the right call. LLMs changed one of the core assumptions behind our 2020 decision, so we reevaluated our mobile stack from first principles. What we found led us back to native.
items.summary: Shopify's decision to move from React Native back to native Swift and Kotlin apps prompted substantial HN discussion about cross-platform tradeoffs and LLM-assisted migrations.
items.detailed_summary_zh: Shopify 工程团队宣布将移动应用从 React Native 迁回原生 Swift 和 Kotlin 开发。这一决定重新审视了公司在 2020 年基于共享代码库等假设所做的选择；Shopify 的 fnthawar2 在讨论中表示，LLM 改变了当时的一项核心假设，因此团队重新评估了原有方案。由于原文正文未提供，目前可见的具体迁移范围、时间表和性能数据有限，Hacker News 的讨论主要围绕跨平台与原生开发的取舍以及 LLM 辅助迁移的可行性展开。
items.background_zh: 背景：Shopify 曾在 2020 年前后从原生开发转向 React Native，用 JavaScript/TypeScript 与 React 组件模型共享 iOS 和 Android 代码；其团队还曾在 React Native Radio 上讲述这段采用经历。Swift 和 Kotlin 分别是 Apple 与 Android 平台的官方原生语言，因此“回到原生”意味着为两大移动平台分别维护 Swift 与 Kotlin 代码库。根据 Shopify 工程博客，2026 年 9 月 10 日发布的文章宣布了这一转向，并把 LLM 视为改变当年跨平台核心假设的因素。

items.title: Global bond sell-off reignites as oil jumps to $109
items.content: US yields reach highs of the day after Scott Bessent’s Treasury buyback operation undershoots its target
items.summary: A global bond sell-off intensified as oil rose to $109, while US yields reached session highs after a Treasury buyback operation fell short of its target.

items.title: Treasury yields jump as Bessent’s $6bn buyback plan disappoints investors
items.content: Ten-year borrowing costs hit highest level in nearly three years despite upsized repurchase programme
items.summary: Treasury yields jumped to nearly three-year highs after Scott Bessent's $6bn buyback plan disappointed investors.
items.detailed_summary_zh: 美国财政部长贝森特（Scott Bessent）规模扩大至60亿美元的国债回购计划未能令投资者满意，十年期美债收益率随之升至近三年最高水平。该收益率反映美国政府十年期借款成本，报道未给出具体点位。
items.background_zh: 美国财政部会回购部分存量国债以支持市场流动性；此次美国财长斯科特·贝森特（Scott Bessent）宣布将长期国债回购规模提高至最多60亿美元，是常规规模的三倍。计划公布后，10年期国债收益率升至近三年高位，市场反应显示投资者认为该力度仍不足。

items.title: BIS chief warns AI capex arms race relies on opaque debt, posing systemic risks
items.summary: The BIS chief warned that an AI capex arms race funded by opaque debt poses systemic risks to financial stability.
items.detailed_summary_zh: 国际清算银行（BIS）负责人警告，围绕人工智能的资本开支竞赛正依赖不透明的债务融资，可能给全球金融稳定带来系统性风险。该警告由BIS方面提出，目前尚无可支撑这一判断的具体数据或政策行动细节。
items.background_zh: 国际清算银行（BIS）是由各国央行共同拥有的国际金融机构，常被称为“央行的央行”，其负责人巴勃罗·埃尔南德斯此次表态的背景是：近年大型科技公司在人工智能上的资本开支与杠杆水平持续上升。他将当前局面与历史上的泡沫相提并论，并称若企业无法实现投资者预期的回报，其潜在破坏力可能超过以往的崩盘。

items.title: Nasdaq invests $100 million in Kraken parent company Payward at $21 billion valuation
items.summary: Nasdaq invested $100 million in Payward, Kraken's parent company, at a $21 billion valuation, signaling continued institutional interest in crypto market infrastructure.
items.detailed_summary_zh: 纳斯达克（Nasdaq）向加密货币交易所Kraken的母公司Payward投资1亿美元，此轮交易对Payward的估值为210亿美元。该投资由纳斯达克方面达成，被视为传统交易所对加密市场基础设施持续感兴趣的信号。
items.background_zh: 纳斯达克是美国主要的证券交易所运营商之一，Kraken 则是大型加密货币交易所，其母公司为 Payward。据彭博社援引知情人士报道，这笔投资由纳斯达克旗下风投部门 Nasdaq Ventures 出资，目的是推进支持“代币化股票”（即把股票以区块链代币形式发行和交易）的基础设施建设。据 Cryptopolitan 报道，纳斯达克由此成为今年第三家入股加密货币交易所的主要交易所运营商。

items.title: Indian agri warehouse giant is putting $2 billion in grain-backed loans onchain
items.summary: An Indian agricultural warehouse company is reportedly putting $2 billion of grain-backed loans onchain.
items.detailed_summary_zh: 据CoinDesk报道，一家印度农业仓储公司据称计划把规模达20亿美元的、以粮食为抵押品的贷款放到区块链上运行。目前公开信息仅有标题，贷款条款、参与方和对照基准均未披露，因此这20亿美元是计划规模还是已有存量尚无法确认。
items.background_zh: 据 CoinDesk 引述的细节，Arya.ag 是印度最大的农业仓储运营商，仓库内持有约20亿美元农作物，并每年促成约13亿美元农业贷款；其计划把仓储收据和贷款状态等记录放到 Avalanche 区块链上，以便贷款方更易核验作为抵押品的粮食。公司尚未披露已有多少此类业务实际迁移上链，也未说明系统何时扩大规模。

items.title: Vantage Data Centers seeks $2bn in loans from Pimco and PGIM
items.content: DigitalBridge-backed firm taps new investors for AI infrastructure as Wall Street banks limit exposure
items.summary: Vantage Data Centers is reportedly seeking $2bn in loans from Pimco and PGIM as the DigitalBridge-backed firm funds AI infrastructure while Wall Street banks curb exposure.
items.detailed_summary_zh: 据英国《金融时报》报道，DigitalBridge 支持的 Vantage Data Centers 正寻求从 Pimco 和 PGIM 获得 20 亿美元贷款，用于为其人工智能基础设施提供资金，此时华尔街银行正在限制相关风险敞口。报道未披露交易条款，融资尚未完成。
items.background_zh: Vantage Data Centers 由数字基础设施投资公司 DigitalBridge 支持，其旗下基金已投资多家超大规模数据中心运营商。在 AI 算力扩张推高数据中心建设资金需求之际，华尔街银行正在收紧相关贷款敞口，Pimco、PGIM 这类机构投资者由此成为替代资金来源。

items.title: Saudi Arabia cuts oil output to lowest this year on Houthi threats
items.content: Rebels announced ‘maritime embargo’ against kingdom’s exports in July, forcing world’s biggest exporter to cut production
items.summary: Saudi Arabia has reportedly reduced oil output to its lowest level this year after Houthi rebels announced a maritime embargo on the kingdom's exports.
items.detailed_summary_zh: 据英国《金融时报》报道，沙特阿拉伯已将其石油产量削减至今年以来的最低水平。此前，胡塞武装于7月宣布对沙特的石油出口实施“海上封锁”，迫使这个全球最大石油出口国减少生产。报道未提供具体产量数字。
items.background_zh: 此前，也门胡塞武装于7月宣布对沙特出口实施“海上封锁”，沙特随后停止从西海岸经曼德海峡装载原油出口，并将部分对亚洲客户的原油改道苏伊士运河。

items.title: Anthropic details distillation campaigns from Alibaba, Moonshot AI, and DeepSeek
items.content: A new report released Thursday by Anthropic alleges persistent distillation attacks by China-based AI companies, which have escalated in recent months as competition in the space has intensified.
items.summary: Anthropic reportedly released a report alleging persistent distillation campaigns by Alibaba, Moonshot AI, and DeepSeek amid intensifying AI competition.
items.detailed_summary_zh: Anthropic 于周四发布一份报告，指控多家中国 AI 公司对其模型实施持续性的蒸馏攻击（distillation attacks）。报告点名阿里巴巴、月之暗面（Moonshot AI）和 DeepSeek 三家中国 AI 公司。据 TechCrunch 记者 Russell Brandom 报道，Anthropic 称此类行为近几个月有所升级，背景是 AI 领域竞争不断加剧。目前公开的报道摘要内容简短，未披露具体技术细节、证据，也未说明涉及的具体模型、时间范围或数据规模。
items.background_zh: 模型蒸馏通常指用能力更强的模型的输出来训练或改进另一个模型；未经授权执行此类操作可能违反服务条款，并被视为不当提取模型能力。Anthropic 曾在 2026 年 2 月表示发现 DeepSeek、Moonshot 和 MiniMax 发起“工业级”蒸馏活动，随后在 2026 年 6 月又指控阿里巴巴开展类似活动。此次报告延续了这些指控，并将矛头指向阿里巴巴、Moonshot AI 和 DeepSeek 等中国 AI 公司。

items.title: Europe’s top regulator questions Polymarket and Kalshi’s EU access, warns of authorization gaps
items.summary: Europe's top regulator is questioning Polymarket and Kalshi's EU access and warning about authorization gaps, according to the headline.
items.detailed_summary_zh: 欧洲最高监管机构对预测市场平台 Polymarket 和 Kalshi 进入欧盟市场提出质疑，并警告存在授权缺口。目前公开信息未显示正式执法行动、具体规则变更或相关数据，监管范围仍不明确。
items.background_zh: ESMA（欧洲证券和市场管理局）是欧盟的证券监管机构。该机构认为预测市场的“事件合约”属于衍生品，而欧盟已禁止向散户投资者销售二元期权，因此这类平台通常需要取得相应授权才能向欧盟用户提供服务。

items.title: More questions about whether researchers can trust OpenAI with unpublished math
items.content:
https://mathstodon.xyz/@andreasthom/117240536885387540

https://mathstodon.xyz/@andreasthom/117240537520615623

https://x.com/ValerioCapraro/status/2097791836269977996, https://xcancel.com/ValerioCapraro/status/209779183626997799...

https://bsky.app/profile/did:plc:ckaz32jwl6t2cno6fmuw2nhn/po... --- Top Comments --- [nezi]: I think it's a useful analogy to compare OpenAI to a human collaborator. These researchers willingly collaborated with an OpenAI model, giving it ideas, and OpenAI provided useful replies. Then, OpenAI goes ahead and publishes work along the lines of this collaboration, without attributing the researchers. If OpenAI was in fact a human researcher, this would be highly unethical. Now, OpenAI is claiming that the model it used to generate the result was not trained on these collaborative c... [sashank_1509]: Both things can be true: 1. OpenAI when using your chats in pretraining is improving its model’s intuition. The model parameter size is massive, and while the data is OOM larger it is plausible that model remembers stuff about chats that improves its latent representation. 2. During RL on verifiable math and massive compute, the model discovers techniques and connections to solve math problems that are superhuman and have little to do with some specific technique mentioned in its chat. The ru... [bertonvv]: I've been wondering whether AI really is improving rapidly at open problems or we're being fooled. - OpenAI invites researchers to use their models, in fact giving at least 100,000 researchers free access[1], but there are also those that pay - Internal OpenAI models are reportedly solving open problems at a surprisingly fast rate[2] - But researchers will typically work on open problems. A researcher who is using Codex to make progress on open problems will be feeding it fresh trai... [fwlr]: It is suspicious that OpenAI decided to generate 300 billion output tokens from a model still in training, right after learning there was a credible chance that a major math proof was in that model’s training data. Obviously there are reasonably plausible explanations for each step, but it does sort of feel like parallel construction. [sk4rekr0w]: "We can say categorically that it is impossible for Dr. Buckmaster’s Codex prompts over the last two months to have influenced the system in any way, including training." This is the third day of total hysteria that is based on nothing of substance. Move on folks.
items.summary: A high-engagement Hacker News discussion (links plus partial comments) questioning whether OpenAI can be trusted with researchers' unpublished mathematical work, centered on attribution and training-data concerns.
items.detailed_summary_zh: 这是一个 Hacker News 链接帖（601 分、601 条评论），指向 Mathstodon、X 和 Bluesky 上一组围绕“研究者能否信任 OpenAI 处理未发表数学成果”的讨论；帖子正文只有链接，没有文章内容。评论者就归属与训练数据展开争论：有人将 OpenAI 类比为人类合作者，认为使用研究者分享的思路却不给予署名在伦理上不可接受；也有人主张，模型既可能在预训练中吸收聊天内容，也可能通过可验证数学任务上的强化学习独立发现技巧，两者可以同时成立。评论中还出现 10 万名研究者免费访问、3000 亿输出 token 以及“Dr. Buckmaster 的 Codex 提示”等具体说法，但这些内容被截断，无法从现有材料核实。整体讨论集中在信任、署名和模型训练数据来源，尚未形成结论。
items.background_zh: 2026年9月，OpenAI 宣称解决了纳维–斯托克斯方程存在性与光滑性问题，但在其公布前约12小时，数学家 Tristan Buckmaster（并部分代表 Levent Alpöge）已声称在相关进展上取得突破，由此引发了关于成果优先权与署名的公开争议。随后数学家 Andreas Thom 也提出质疑，怀疑自己与 ChatGPT 的私人研究对话被用于模型训练，并称 OpenAI 起初表示从未接触其聊天记录，之后却无法排除这一可能。这两起事件叠加，使「研究者能否放心把未发表数学工作交给 AI 模型」成为社区焦点，Terence Tao 等数学家此前也对 AI 数学研究的某些倾向表达过保留意见。

items.title: Cognition launches new SWE-2 model, Rivaling Fable 5.1 and GPT-Astra
items.content:
--- Top Comments ---

[postalcoder]: If you're looking for reason to be skeptical, look no further than the massive delta between the Terminal Bench 2.1 (92.8%) and the Terminal Bench 4 score (27.3%). Terminal Bench 4 was released a couple weeks ago, so the difference you're seeing between the two scores can be interpreted as "how well does this model generalize to new problems"? More crudely: "how benchmaxxed is this model?"

[gruez]: Cognition, the same company that a few years ago demoed a coding bot purporting to be able to autonomously complete upwork tasks, but upon closer inspection was going off the rails and not even completing what was asked?  https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=tNmgmwEtoWE  As others have mentioned this is post trained from Kimi k3, which is already quite capable, so it can't be that bad, but any claimed improvements in performance should be taken with a grain of salt.

[nullbio]: Where are the model stats? Is this open-weights? If not, why would I use this over DeepSeek Flash 4.1? I think these competing labs need to realize that no one wants another closed-weight model provider... We aren't even happy with the two we have right now, and their days are entirely numbered. If DeepSeek 4.1 flash is really as good as it's benching, we're probably a month away from 1/3rd of users moving off the closed-weight models in favor of something they have more c...

[TheJCDenton]: > SWE-2 is post-trained from Kimi K3 On the one hand I would have expected a completely new model, on the other hand it's an RL-ed K3 go Fable 5 capabilities, which demonstrate that this is probably possible, which is nice.

[pkilgore]: Not sure it matters when devin is the most consistently shit product I've used.  And yes, I tried again, they wasted the money on the billboards.
items.summary: Cognition announced a new SWE-2 coding model positioned against rival models, but the announcement lacks technical and licensing details and its benchmark claims are met with community skepticism.
items.detailed_summary_zh: Cognition（Devin 的开发公司）在其博客发布了新的编码模型 SWE-2，并在标题中将其与 Fable 5.1、GPT-Astra 等竞品模型相提并论。公告未披露模型架构、训练细节、许可证类型或可用性信息，因而被批评为内容偏宣传性质。社区对其基准成绩普遍持怀疑态度：有评论者指出该模型在 Terminal Bench 2.1 上得分 92.8%，而在几周前刚发布的 Terminal Bench 4 上仅为 27.3%，这一巨大落差被解读为泛化能力不足或“刷榜”。另有评论提到 SWE-2 是在 Kimi K3 基础上进行后训练（含强化学习）得到的，认为底子不弱，但宣称的性能提升仍应谨慎看待。
items.background_zh: Cognition 是自主编程代理 Devin 的开发公司，本次发布的 SWE-2 被定位为其“最先进的编程模型”，提供于 Devin Desktop、CLI，并陆续上线 Devin Web 与 Fusion，而非面向通用 API 的模型产品。社区评论指出 SWE-2 是在既有基座模型上后训练（post-training）而来，而非从零训练的新模型，这决定了对其能力提升幅度的解读方式。Terminal Bench 是评估编程代理在终端环境中执行任务的基准测试，社区正是借助其 2.1 与 4 两个版本间的分数落差来判断模型对未见问题的泛化能力；与此同时，闭源权重与开源权重之争是此类模型发布时的常见背景。

items.title: OpenAI puts Pro subscriptions on hold due to Astra demand
items.content: The company said Pro subscriptions put the most strain on its systems, so it's pausing sign-ups while adding more capacity.
items.summary: OpenAI is pausing new Pro subscription sign-ups to add capacity, citing system strain from demand for Astra.
items.detailed_summary_zh: OpenAI 已暂停新的 Pro 订阅注册，理由是需要先扩充容量，并称 Astra 带来的需求使系统承受压力。该公司表示，Pro 订阅对其系统造成的压力最大，因此在增加容量的同时暂停了注册。这一举措意味着在容量补充到位之前，新用户暂时无法订购 Pro 计划。现有报道未说明 Astra 是什么、需求规模有多大，也未给出暂停的持续时间或恢复注册的时间表。
items.background_zh: Astra 是 OpenAI 近期推出的新一代旗舰模型，被描述为其能力最强的模型，并已在外部报道中被与 AGI 等话题联系在一起；不同来源对其发布时间与开放范围说法不一，有报道称其先向网络安全研究人员开放、并在当周内向所有订阅用户提供，也有报道指出 OpenAI 尚未公布正式发布日期（tool-1-2、tool-1-3）。OpenAI 官方材料还展示了 Astra 依据演示模板自动生成幻灯片的能力，强调其符合企业格式规范（tool-1-1）。这些背景有助于理解为何新增 Pro 订阅会对系统容量造成压力。

items.title: AI agents are flooding public services with new requests
items.content: “The vast majority of cases we find are people who are entitled to claim for something, claiming for that thing,” the researcher told TechCrunch.
items.summary: A TechCrunch article reportedly describes AI agents generating a surge of requests to public services, though the supplied excerpt contains only a brief researcher quote.
items.detailed_summary_zh: TechCrunch 于 2026 年 9 月 10 日刊发、由 Russell Brandom 撰写的报道称，AI 代理正在向公共服务系统提交大量新请求，给这些服务带来新增负担。但就目前可获得的内容而言，文章仅提供了一位研究者的简短引述，没有给出具体请求数量、涉及机构、技术实现方式、证据或系统影响的说明。该研究者对 TechCrunch 表示，他们发现的绝大多数情况是“有权申领某项福利的人正在申领那项福利”，这暗示新增请求中相当一部分可能属于正当申领，而非滥用行为。由于原始材料非常有限，这轮请求激增的规模、成因与后果目前都无法核实，相关结论仍有待更完整的报道或数据支撑。
items.background_zh: AI 代理（AI agents）指能够代表用户自动执行多步任务的软件，例如填写表格、提交申请或发出投诉。随着生成式 AI 降低操作门槛，各国公共服务可能迎来申请和请求量的激增；TechCrunch 报道称，研究者 Chris Schmitz 已记录 11 个国家、84 起所谓“agentic flooding”案例，英国等地的投诉系统也出现异常增长。不过，目前披露的细节有限，研究者强调多数案例是符合资格者在申领应得权益，而非明显欺诈。

items.title: India’s Pocket FM doubles revenue run rate to $500M as AI powers 93% of audio content
items.content: Pocket FM uses AI to produce 99% of its new content, helping make content production about 80 times cheaper.
items.summary: Pocket FM has doubled its revenue run rate to $500M while using AI to produce nearly all new audio content at much lower cost, according to a TechCrunch report.
items.detailed_summary_zh: 据 TechCrunch 报道，印度音频平台 Pocket FM 的收入运行率翻倍至 5 亿美元，并称其 99% 的新内容由 AI 生成，内容制作成本因此降低约 80 倍。报道未披露收入翻倍所对应的对比期，成本与 AI 占比数据来自公司说法。
items.background_zh: Pocket FM 是2018年在印度班加罗尔成立的长篇音频故事平台，主打连续更新的音频剧集。所谓“营收运行率”，是把最近一段时间的收入按当前速度折算成全年规模的估算值，并非已经实现的全年收入。
